notes: CodeSystem https://fhir.dghs.gov.bd/core/CodeSystem/bd-geocodes version 0.5.0, status draft, date 2026-10-15T00:09:54+00:00, 1591 codes nationally. Divisions, districts, upazilas/city thanas, city corporations and paurashavas only: no union-level codes (only 'Unions Of X Upazila' placeholders). The IG does not say which BBS release the codes come from.
